name: Chelsea Piers Athletic Club Stamford Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly sports day camps at Chelsea Piers' Athletic Club in Stamford, including a general multi-sport camp (Camp Chelsea) and single-sport camps such as hockey, gymnastics, tennis, basketball and ninja/parkour. Full-day camps for ages 5-13 run 8:45am-3:45pm, preschool camps for ages 3-5 run half or most of the day, and you can enroll for one week or the whole summer.
swim_waterfront_notes: Indoor pool. Preschool Gymnastics + Swimming and Preschool Tennis + Swimming camps (ages 3-5) spend the afternoon in a "warm water pool" working on basic swim technique and pool safety.
